# Source Tier

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SourceTier>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/evidence`](../../slices/evidence.md)

The bibliographic tier of a source — primary, secondary, or tertiary — a value vocabulary (individuals, never subclasses). This is the standard source-tier axis applied to notability assessment (cf. WP:GNG).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SourceTier`](gmeow-SourceTier.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
